Accepted surfaces will receive suitable loose-residue collection and compatible cleaning, with inaccessible interiors identified.

sections.title: Review the result before reassembly or return
sections.text: A limited treatment can inform whether similar components merit further work. We will report remaining staining, odor and attachment damage, keeping repair or disposal approval separate from cleaning. Completed suitable parts will be appropriately dry and protected; a clean front will not establish that the assembled furniture is stable.

fire-damaged-contents-cleaning/hackberry.estimate: Panel construction, edge damage, safe disassembly and component quantity affect the estimate. Furniture repair or specialist evaluation may be needed beyond residue cleaning.
checklist: Identify affected furniture and visible edge or joint damage.
Share heat and firefighting-water exposure if known.
Note pieces that should not be disassembled without approval.

fire-extinguisher-residue-cleanup/hackbe.intro: Fire extinguisher residue cleanup in Hackberry can require cleaning movable carts after discharged agent reaches their wheels and the floor below. We will identify the agent and control movement before rolling contaminated parts into an otherwise unaffected room.

sections.title: Inspect the wheel assembly before moving the cart
sections.text: Residue may sit on wheel treads, around forks or beneath lower shelves. We will review agent information and the accessible surfaces, then plan a protected handling route. The amount visible on a shelf does not establish what the wheels could transfer along the floor.

sections.title: Collect deposits from the included parts
sections.text: Suitable agent-specific collection will precede compatible cleaning of accessible treads, supports and shelf undersides. Safe lifting or authorized detachment may be needed for access and will be planned according to the equipment. Enclosed bearings, brakes or powered components need appropriate technical evaluation rather than an exterior-cleaning claim.

sections.title: Clean the footprint before returning movable storage
sections.text: We will treat included floor deposits and distinguish cleaned cart surfaces from unresolved internal mechanisms. Coating changes, corrosion or operating problems remain repair questions. The cart will return only under the agreed handling arrangement, with inaccessible parts and any remaining treatment recorded.

fire-extinguisher-residue-cleanup/hackbe.estimate: Agent type, cart construction, wheel access and the affected floor route influence the scope. Mechanical servicing and equipment testing are separate from residue cleanup.
checklist: Photograph the extinguisher label if safe.
Identify carts and the routes used after discharge.
Note brakes, powered parts or lifting restrictions.

emergency-board-up-after-fire/hackberry.intro: Emergency board up after fire in Hackberry can require temporary coverage over a recessed opening with projecting trim. We will measure the actual exposure and usable support so the panel can be secured without relying on decorative material that cannot carry it.

sections.title: Measure the support plane as well as the opening
sections.text: A deep recess or projecting surround can prevent a flat panel from seating where expected. We will inspect accessible perimeter condition and identify sound fixing locations. Loose or weakened decorative trim needs an appropriate handling decision before coverage is fitted.

sections.title: Fit temporary coverage to the observed geometry
sections.text: The agreed method may require a suitably planned support arrangement rather than forcing a panel against uneven trim. Appropriate materials will be cut, positioned and fastened to suitable support, then checked for movement and uncovered gaps. Structural stabilization remains a separate task when the remaining opening cannot support temporary coverage.

sections.title: Keep later repair access in the fitting plan
sections.text: We will identify how authorized inspection or replacement work can proceed without unintentionally leaving the exposure open. Temporary panels do not establish permanent weatherproofing, structural safety or occupancy permission. Changes to the remaining frame may require the closure to be refitted as repair work advances.

emergency-board-up-after-fire/hackberry.estimate: Recess depth, projecting features, opening height and usable attachment affect labor and materials. Availability is confirmed for the address; permanent reconstruction has a separate scope.
checklist: Share the opening dimensions and photographs from a safe location.
Identify projecting trim or damaged perimeter sections.
Provide site-release status and the authorized access contact.

crawl-space-sewage-cleanup/hackberry.intro: Crawl space sewage cleanup in Hackberry can involve wastewater among loose gravel beneath the floor. We will distinguish reachable liquid, contaminated ground material and affected building components before proposing removal and retained-surface treatment.

sections.title: Evaluate the loose ground layer separately
sections.text: Gravel can conceal settled material or liquid below its visible surface. We will review accessible contact and source findings before defining the work area. The scope will state whether additional ground-layer evaluation or removal is needed; a cleaner-looking upper surface will not establish that the underlying material was treated.

sections.title: Collect wastewater and handle contaminated material
sections.text: Reachable wastewater and specified affected debris will be collected using suitable controls and transfer arrangements. Ground material designated for removal needs an agreed method and disposal plan, with excavation or disturbance near foundations requiring appropriate evaluation. Suitable retained building surfaces will have soil and residue physically removed before appropriate disinfection.

sections.title: Keep ground findings separate from the floor structure
sections.text: We will inspect reachable joists, subfloor and insulation for contact and identify removal or drying needed there. Replacing a ground covering or adding fresh gravel must not hide unresolved contamination. The handoff will distinguish completed building treatment, ground work and areas not reached, with plumbing correction separately recorded.

crawl-space-sewage-cleanup/hackberry.estimate: Ground-layer condition, access, contamination extent and disposal quantities affect the scope. Work beyond Go Green’s authority is referred to an appropriately licensed provider, identified before work begins.
checklist: Describe the visible ground covering without entering.
Share the drain-line source and repair status.
Provide existing inspection photographs or access information.
